newsitem.headline: EP External Economic Relations Committee agenda - Jun 30-Jul 1.

Committee on External Economic Relations [[ Monday 30 June 1997 ]] P U B L I C M E E T I N G
===] Monday 30 June at 3 pm
1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.522 )
2. Chairman's announcements
===] In the presence of the Council and Commission
3. Exchange of views with Mr MARIN at 3 pm on, inter alia, - Mexico - Mercosur - Peace process in the Mediterranean - G.C.C. - Cuba - Mediterranean policy
4. Information from the Commission on state of progress
